dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Bodle is at risk due to behavior concerns. His previous owner described him as a medium to high energy dog that will tolerate some handling, such as having his feet or collar touched. He arrived at the care centers through the field team after a bite incident in the home. Bodle is reported to have bitten his previous owner's sibling while they were lying in bed. This resulted in the victim requiring stitches at urgent care to treat the injuries sustained. His previous owner stated that, prior to this incident, Bodle had never bitten or had rough play behavior. During his time at the care centers he has readily taken treats through the kennel bars. Medically, he is apparently healthy.

Bodle was surrendered to the care center by his previous owner due to behavior concerns. Bodle is reported to have bitten the previous owner's sibling, jumping onto the bed while they had the covers pulled over their head and biting their face, splitting the eyelid and requiring stitches. Bodle's previous owner also reports that he may hard stare and growl at unfamiliar people who approach the family. Outside of this incident, they describe him as a playful dog who likes to spend time where his people are. Due to concerns about his behavior in the home environment, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide an experienced, adult-only foster home, provide decompression and any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
